# Proposal: add-voucher-redemption

<!-- Generated by re-skills to-openspec from requirements/requirements.csv on 2026-11-03. R-IDs are trace anchors: keep them in commits and test names. Change requirement text in the register and re-export; do not edit it here. -->

## Why

Members collect points to redeem them, and today they cannot turn points into a voucher or have a voucher confirmed at the till. This change implements the agreed redemption requirements so the new loyalty service can replace the legacy module at checkout.

## What Changes

- R-040 Issue voucher on redemption request (must)
- R-041 Validate voucher at checkout (must)
- R-042 Reject redemption below minimum (must)

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities

- `voucher-redemption`: members redeem posted points as vouchers, and the POS confirms a voucher at checkout (R-040, R-041, R-042)

### Modified Capabilities

- None

## Constraints and Quality Requirements

| ID | Type | Requirement | Source | Verification |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R-085 | Q | WHILE the POS load is at most 9000 purchases per minute across stores, the loyalty service shall answer 95% of voucher validation requests within 300 ms. | I-02 (Arjun Pillai SH-02); peak load SH-08 | test |
| R-100 | C | The loyalty service shall implement the voucher validation call as defined in the TillPoint POS loyalty interface spec v2.1 (S-02). | S-02; SH-09 POS vendor | inspection |

## Impact

- POS (TillPoint) voucher validation call (R-041, R-085, R-100)
- Customer mobile app voucher request (R-040, R-042)
- Register: `requirements/requirements.csv`

## Not in this change

None.
